method: Mean/zero-ablate the LAST-token output (matched single position, no length confound) of each layer's attention-write (o_proj) and MLP-write; next-token KL per object-count group; localize via Spearman(KL, object-count) + c2-vs-c0 t. Attn-vs-MLP = OV-vs-FFN.
scope: Hunts the object-application mechanism after s250 showed the FFN C-field is a readout register, not the mechanism.
